reviews.title: What? Need a local provider?
reviews.text:
Wanted to watch a movie when Spectrum was out, so tried this app. Needed to have a local provider? 
I stream everything but Spectrum was out again, so I planned to use my cellular day and local hotspot. Did NOT work. I cancelled the subscription within minutes.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: After connecting the screen lagged by several seconds and never could get it to work properly

reviews.title: It sucks
reviews.text:
It didn’t work, I accepted a 3 day trial, but can’t figure out where to cancel. 
So it sucks.

reviews.title: Very glitchy
reviews.text: So slow!!!  and kept dropping out. It’s a delete app from me

reviews.title: Don’t do it
reviews.text: It doesn’t say, until you download the app, that it doesn’t work if your tv is connected to sky or other system.  Then there’s no way of cancelling the trial!!!

reviews.title: mid
reviews.text: This is okay, I used the free trial and worked well just had a slight delay of about 7 seconds and it was fine good audio e.c.t so given how good it seemed I bought the year long subscription for about £19.99 and then it got bad, it would randomly disconnected, and then a day or so after when I next use the app it would claim there’s no tv to connect too, I don’t believe it was an issue on my end as I checked my network and settings e.c.t so I’m still trying to get it to find my tv I’m quite disappointed.

reviews.title: Poor experience
reviews.text: It connected for about 7 minutes in total and then failed and wouldnt reconnect. Tried troubleshooting, restarting etc but no joy.

reviews.title: Sneaky fees (scam)
reviews.text: Gets you into a “click next” (click-click-click) pattern then slips in major monthly subscription.  Screen casting is a free feature that comes standard with any TV purchased in the last decade, yet this app has the gall to charge people for what equates to a quick YouTube tutorial.  🙄

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text:
Have the app. Have an LG tv. Both on the same network, but still can’t see my tv on the app.
Deleted and found an alternative option.

reviews.title: Can’t get to work
reviews.text:
Paid full year subscription then realised it won’t connect to my tv

Then downloaded one that should connect to my tv and had to subscribe again. 
Now still won’t connect to my tv

Very poor

reviews.title: Wasted Purchase
reviews.text: NOT User Friendly, in fact unable to use period! It doesn’t work! The app that you purchase when trying to mirror your tv is going to tell you that you need to enter a pin it gives you a 6-digit pin that you have nowhere to enter it. On your device it states it’s connected but you will see NOTHING! This is the frustration you just paid for! You were looking to pay for another frustration in your life right??? 😡
